title: Drift Away Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 3 KING bedrooms with TVs, all with private baths - Bunk room and additional living space upstairs with TV for the kids - Access to community pool - Beautifully decorated throughout with new furnishings - 2 Bikes - Backyard entertaining area with grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Walking distance to Red Fish Village and several Blue Mountain restaurant favorites! - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). Drift Away is located in the heart of Blue Mountain in a newer community. 5 minute walk to the beach, Drift Away has 4BR and sleeps 10 comfortably. Floor 1: Gorgeous Kitchen open to Great room and Dining area with Huge TV King Suite with Private full bath 1/2 Bath Outdoor access to front porch with Adirondack chairs and back yard Floor 2: King Suite, TV, Private on suite bath King Suite, TV, Private on suite bath Bunk room with 4 twins, private bath Second living room with large TV- perfect hanout for the kids!
